notes: kaʾăšer is one `noncompositional` unit because the ASV writes a single *as*; the source head is the governing opening morpheme per rule 23's ruling on `כַּאֲשֶׁר`. Contrast DEU.10.9, where the ASV writes the two-word compound *according as*.
šām (s020) holds the written *there*; the *they are* is hāyāh's own subject pronoun and copula under rule 17, not rule 21's presentative dummy.
